data.title: Jazan Municipality Prepares 737 Tourism and Leisure Facilities for Autumn Break
data.content:
Jizan, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Jazan Region Municipality has prepared 737 tourism and leisure facilities across Jazan city and the region's governorates and centers to welcome residents and visitors during the autumn break. The preparations are part of its efforts to enhance quality of life and provide recreational destinations where visitors can enjoy the region's mild weather and diverse natural attractions.
    Municipality Spokesperson Dr. Ibrahim Al-Khayyat said the facilities include 270 parks and viewpoints, 225 sports fields, 18 waterfronts, and 224 walkways. He explained that the waterfronts feature walking paths, seaside seating areas, designated children's play areas, restaurants, cafés, and supporting services. Parks offer green spaces and recreational facilities, while walkways provide safe, well-equipped environments for physical activity.
    Al-Khayyat added that the municipality continues to carry out maintenance and operational work, including maintaining green spaces, children's play equipment, and lighting networks. It is also stepping up cleaning operations, addressing visual blight, and intensifying environmental sanitation efforts to ensure the facilities are ready to receive visitors, safeguard public safety, and improve service quality.
    He noted that these preparations enhance Jazan's appeal as a tourist destination by providing diverse recreational options for residents and visitors during the holiday. He also urged the public to protect public property and report any issues through the unified call center at 940, helping preserve the region's cleanliness and aesthetic appeal.
    -- SPA
